prompt.en: Which beach did 15,000 Canadian troops storm and capture on D-Day, June 6, 1944?
prompt.fr: Quelle plage 15 000 soldats canadiens ont-ils prise d'assaut le jour J, le 6 juin 1944?

explanation.en: Juno was the stretch of Normandy coast that 15,000 Canadians took on 6 June 1944, the landing we call D-Day. Roughly one Allied soldier in ten ashore that morning came from Canada.
explanation.fr: Juno est la portion de la côte normande que 15 000 Canadiens ont enlevée le 6 juin 1944, le débarquement qu'on appelle le jour J. Environ un soldat allié sur dix débarqué ce matin-là venait du Canada.

source.quote: 15,000 Canadian troops stormed and captured Juno Beach from the German Army

verification.evidence: In the epic invasion of Normandy in northern France on June 6, 1944, known as D-Day, 15,000 Canadian troops stormed and captured Juno Beach from the German Army, a great national achievement shown in this painting by Orville Fisher. Approximately one in ten Allied soldiers on D-Day was Canadian.
